answer: Tie issuance to graded-work history: a new identity earns at a base rate and only climbs as its past answers are graded real and useful, like an oasis field that widens with proven work. The cost is time times exposure: every fake must survive a saffron of grading rounds before its rate is worth anything. A farm's first epoch pays like a karst — and so does its twentieth, until it earns more.
